name: Ira Grachevskaya
source:
A problem child and a truant, Ira doesn't have the best reputation. Her standoffish demeanor makes her difficult to talk to, especially for someone as meek as you. There is a rumour she's been meeting with an older man.

[From the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4122860/ZATO__I_Love_the_World_and_Everything_In_It/]Steam page[/url]]
